args.body: PARTLY EVALUATED: 1 of the 2 checks could not be run at all -- lift_carries_the_weight (the question asked is about POWERED flight, and this check cannot answer it. It compares lift with weight at a given airspeed, which is an area question; powered flight is a power question -- whether the flight muscle can supply the induced and profile power through a wingbeat, continuously, at that animal's mass. That needs a coefficient measured through a wingbeat and a muscle power density for the clade, and this repository has neither.). The checks that did run found no contradiction, and a check that did not run is not a check that passed. The refusal is about POWERED flight, which is the deeper of the two reasons this could not be answered: an area inequality is not a power budget.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
